newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 1c to 569c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 1c to 569c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose by one cent to 569 cents a kg clean at sales in Goulburn and Melbourne on Wednesday, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices remained mixed, with the 19/21/22 micron indicators slightly dearer.
The 20m category was slightly cheaper while 23m was unchanged. The 24/26m categories were 0.5 percent dearer while 25m was up to 1.0 percent dearer, WI said.
In merino skirtings, 19m was generally unchanged, while 20/21/22m were slightly dearer.
In crossbreds, 27/31m were slightly dearer, 28/29m 0.5 percent dearer and 30m up to 1.0 percent dearer, it said.
WI said Japanese, Chinese and Western European interests were principal buyers with support from Taiwan.
Of 21,970 bales offered in both centres, 9.1 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Goulburn, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 38,000 bales to be offered.
